reason: A browser voice-mode plugin that captures speech, performs host-side ASR, submits transcripts to the model, and streams synthesized audio responses with barge-in support.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全双工语音交互，支持麦克风输入、本地语音识别、流式语音播放、实时字幕和语音打断。
summaries.en: Adds full-duplex voice interaction to DeepSeek Harness with microphone input, host-side speech recognition, streamed spoken replies, live captions, and voice interruption.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio in the browser
Sends raw PCM audio to a host-side ASR endpoint
Uses SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx for speech recognition
Streams LLM responses as synthesized audio with captions
Fetches and caches speech model files through a configurable proxy
Cancels playback and an active model turn when speech interruption is detected
